summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of new role-based user management. 19/19 backend pytest tests passed (auth login/signup, /auth/me, RBAC 401/403 gates, admin CRUD incl. self-delete guard, password update + relogin, chat isolation between users). Frontend E2E covered: unauth login page, wrong-password error, admin login + admin badge, User Management modal (add/edit/delete), all 5 admin Settings tabs, sign-out, regular-user signup + no admin-badge + no admin-panel + only 3 settings tabs (general/theme/system) + model dropdown visible, no 401 console errors post-login, localStorage token persistence across reload.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close modals. Only the X icon or Cancel button close them. Not blocking, but inconsistent with typical UX.

action_items: Optional: enable Escape-to-close on UserManagement and SettingsModal for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >700 lines (~720). Consider splitting into modules: auth.py, admin.py, chats.py, connections.py, settings.py.
PUT /api/settings and GET /api/settings have no auth guard — any anonymous user can read/overwrite global app settings incl. system prompt. Should be admin-gated.
seed_admin uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan handlers.
Emails are normalized to lower-case on write but /auth/login and /admin update also lower-case on read — good. Ensure signup returns lowercase email consistently in user object (currently it does).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@openwebui.local / Admin@123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Regular users created dynamically as test_*_<ts>@example.com / Test@1234 and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All test users deleted after test runs; only seeded admin remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth + RBAC + admin CRUD + chat isolation fully validated by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Frontend Playwright flows validated: admin login → admin panel → add/edit/delete user; regular user signup shows correct restricted UI (no admin badge, no admin panel menu, no connections/models tabs). Emails are lowercased server-side so any email comparisons in tests must use lowercase. Escape-key close on modals is missing; use Cancel/X button instead. /api/settings is currently public — flag for main agent.
